result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: a raw localization key is displayed instead of a section title.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated, human-readable text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the 'home_feed.popular_title' key is properly defined in the localization files and resolved before rendering (e.g., 'Popular near you').
